![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14151148/assets/a94a13b06d682fe525278b529ed862cbfacecc3a97900ad54a80d66bf4971658.png)

For the diagram shown above, which of the following statements are true?

I. The segments $\overset{―}{AB}$ and $\overset{―}{BC}$ are congruent

II. $\overset{―}{DB}≅\overset{―}{CE}$

III. $AD=2\,\text{cm}$
question.worked_solution:
- Statement I is false. From the picture, the two segments $\overset{―}{AB}$ and $\overset{―}{BC}$ have different hash marks, so 

$$
\overset{―}{AB}≇\overset{―}{BC}.
$$

- Statement II is false. From the picture, the two segments $\overset{―}{DB}$ and $\overset{―}{CE}$ have different hash marks, so 

$$
\overset{―}{DB}≇\overset{―}{CE}.
$$

- Statement III is true. According to the picture, we have that both $\overset{―}{AD}$ and $\overset{―}{BC}$ have the same hash marks, so

$$
\overset{―}{AD}≅\overset{―}{BC}.
$$

Hence, $AD=BC=2\,\text{cm}.$

Therefore, only statement III is true.
